turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi! Can I sit here? I'm Nadia. I started in marketing last week.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Of course, please sit down. Nice to meet you. How's your first week going?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Busy, but everyone's friendly. Did you do anything nice at the weekend?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Nothing special. I watched a football match with my brother on Saturday, and on Sunday I just relaxed at home. What about you?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I went hiking in the mountains with some friends. My legs still hurt!

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That sounds great, but climbing a mountain is a bit too much for me! I prefer the beach, because I can swim and relax.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Ha, fair enough. Where do you usually go?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Usually to the north coast in the summer. The water is really clear there. Have you been to the coast yet?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Not yet. I've only been here for two months.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh, you should go in June, before it gets busy. And by the way, what do you do in marketing exactly?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Mostly social media for our products. I really enjoy it.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That sounds interesting. Oh, it's almost two. I should get back to work, but it was nice to meet you.
